description:
Role Responsibilities :
 This particular role holds responsibility for the commerce live site experience 
 driving performance enhancements, production fixes and quick impacts 
 Maintain a strong culture of innovation, creativity, and fun -Be completely responsible for the delivery of the committed features -Provide leadership and mentor in engineering best practices 
 Responsible for ensuring stability and performance of the products are best in class. This includes accountability for performance, availability management and capacity planning 
 Communicate and translate vision/strategy to staff. Responsible for executing on functional and business goals for the group -Must be a strong technical decision maker 
 Responsible for solving highly technical and complex problems for several programs and projects -Leads the implementation of rigorous engineering excellence process and platform improvement initiatives
 Passionate about the customer experience, and ensure every visit is a great experience 
 

 
 Requirements: 
 -10+ years of relevant work experience leading engineering teams and most of this focused eCommerce Software Development – including testing, designing, and developing complex enterprise applications (THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT)
 - Good communication skills, including the ability to convey technical information effectively to both IT and business audiences 
 Experience leading small and large organizations
 - eCommerce specific industry knowledge and experience in software engineering 
 - Strong organizational planning and development, business judgment, technical leadership, and communication skills -Working knowledge of the sales and the sales processes 
 - Expertise in most of the following –Web API (MS ASP.Net), MVC, WCF, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, SOAP, REST, JQuery, .Net Framework, C#, Web Services 
 - Practical knowledge of object oriented programming -Ability to work across multiple simultaneous product development efforts and programs
 
 What are the three to five technical responsibilities of the position?: 
 Expertise in most of the following –Web API (MS ASP.Net), MVC, WCF, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, SOAP, REST, JQuery, .Net Framework, C#, Web Services

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 Look for: Danielle 
 Phone: 346 231 7544 
 Email: d.garan@computerfutures. com
